item.title: Bravo Releases "Southern Hospitality" Season 4 Trailer, Show Returns March 4
item.description: Bravo has released the first trailer for the upcoming fourth season of Southern Hospitality, the Charleston-based reality television series. The show returns Wednesday, March 4, at 9 p.m.

item.title: Absorbent underwear: a must-have to avoid leakage
item.description: Leakage is among the common life experiences that negatively impact people‘s lives. From light bladder sensitivity and everyday discharges to menstruation and postpartum recovery, managing it properly and comfortably can make a big difference in your confidence. Keep reading to understand how absorbent underwear works and its practical solution in offering built-in protection, while looking and feeling like regular underwear.

item.title: The Tide is Turning: Lowcountry Literacy Project Debuts Documentary to Sold Out Crowd
item.description: The conversation surrounding literacy in the Lowcountry reached a fever pitch last week as over 700 registered attendees gathered at the Charleston Music Hall for the premiere of "The Tide of Change."

item.title: USPS to Reveal Phillis Wheatley Stamp at Avery Research Center
item.description: Residents in the South Carolina Lowcountry will celebrate the unveiling of the United States Postal Services newest postage stamp, which features the late Phillis Wheatley, a formerly enslaved poet of the American Revolution

item.title: Zac Brown Band to Play Credit One Stadium Sept. 17
item.description: Zac Brown Band (ZBB), the Grammy Award-winning Southern rock and country group, will bring its Love & Fear Tour to Credit One Stadium on Thursday, Sept. 17. The band will be joined by special guest Brothers Osborne.

item.title: Charleston City Hall to be Illuminated in Yellow Tuesday in Honor of International Holocaust Remembrance Day
item.description: Charleston City Hall will be illuminated in yellow on Jan. 27 in observance of International Holocaust Remembrance Day, in partnership with the Jewish Federation of Greater Charleston.

item.title: Brandon Brown and Jesse Jackson Jr. to Host Joint Fundraiser in Greenville
item.description: Brandon Brown, Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in South Carolina, and Jesse Jackson Jr., Democratic candidate for Congress in Illinois’ 2nd District, will host a joint fundraiser on Saturday, February 7, in Greenville, South Carolina

item.title: America Turns 250 and Emeline Celebrates with Red, White & Charleston
item.description: America is turning 250, and Charleston is one of just four destinations being spotlighted nationwide for the anniversary.

item.title: New Poll: Republican Primary Voters Back Conservation, Resilience and Energy Planning at Record Levels
item.description: A new statewide poll of 1,200 likely Republican primary voters finds strong and growing support for conservation, resilience and responsible natural resource management across South Carolina
